notes.title: 🎉 Super Ultimate Party Game — Public Playtest Starts Now! 🎉
notes.notes: [p]Hey Partiers![/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that [b]our first public playtest is officially live[/b]! 🎮 This is your chance to jump into the chaos early and help shape the future of [i]Super Ultimate Party Game[/i].[/p][p]✅ How to Join:[/p][p]Click the green [b]"Request Access"[/b] button on our Steam store page to get started! Once you're in, you'll also be able to [b]invite up to 3 friends[/b] to join the fun with you![/p][p]💬 Share Your Thoughts:[/p][p]This playtest is all about gathering your feedback and squashing any bugs along the way. You can share your thoughts in two ways:[/p][list][*][p][b]In-game survey[/b] (link in the main menu)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Join our[/b] [b][url="https://discord.gg/PzYjrQeVjy"]Discord[/url][/b] to chat directly with the devs and other players![/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for being part of this early adventure — we can’t wait to party with you![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Super Ultimate Party Game first playtest!
notes.notes:
🎉 Hello Partiers! 🎉
Starting next weekend — Friday, the 6th — we’re kicking off our first playtest for Super Ultimate Party Game!

This will be a limited event hosted through our [url=https://discord.gg/PzYjrQeVjy]Discord[/url] server, where we’ll be handing out Steam keys for the playtest.

🎮 Join the server, invite your friends, and get ready to party!
